Package GUI

Class ParkWorkerDashboardController

java.lang.Object
GUI.ParkWorkerDashboardController
public class ParkWorkerDashboardController extends Object
Controller for the Park Worker Dashboard. This class manages the main dashboard displayed to park workers. It allows workers to access the park entry and exit screens, edit their profile, log out of the system, or exit the application.
